A '''bow''' is a charged {{MCD2|ranged weapon}} that fires arrows.

== Obtaining ==
The bow can be obtained in the following areas:
* {{MCD2Link|Honeycomb Fields}}
* {{MCD2Link|id=Deep Dark|The Deep Dark}}
* {{MCD2Link|Rainy Plains}}

It can also be obtained from dungeons in the following areas:
* {{MCD2Link|Frozen Highlands}}
* {{MCD2Link|Howling Woods}}
* {{MCD2Link|Honeycomb Fields}}
* {{MCD2Link|Rainy Plains}}

== Usage ==
Bows can fire immediately for minimum damage, but holding the ranged attack button causes it to charge the arrow, dealing the maximum damage after a short charge time.
